name: DecodeBase64
description: Decode base64 content of any message and copy the decoded content.
summary: A hover-bar button that decodes or copies a message's Base64; also in its menu

settings.label: Click method
settings.description: Change the button to decode base64 content of any message.

choices.label: Left Click to decode the base64 content.
Right click to decode the base64 content.

notes: A message's hover bar gets upstream's decode button: a left click shows the decoded text and a right click copies it, swapped when Click method is Right; its tooltip says which is which. Like upstream, every run of four or more Base64 characters (with optional = padding) is decoded, and the ones that make valid UTF-8 text are kept. Decode shows them in a "Decoded Base64 Content" window, each in a code box with Copy ("Decoded content copied to clipboard!"). A message with nothing to decode says "No Base64 content found in this message.". Qord also puts both actions in the message's right-click menu, the click method's left-click one first. On purpose, unlike upstream: copying puts all decoded parts on the clipboard, one per line (upstream copies each in turn, so only the last stays), and non-ASCII text is decoded as UTF-8 (upstream shows it byte by byte).
